'''Herglic's Folly''' was a gambling district located within [[Worlport/Legends|Worlport]], the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]]. The most dangerous of Worlport's three gambling districts, Herglic's Folly was named for the [[Herglic/Legends|Herglic]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. Street fights were an everyday occurrence in the streets, and drug addiction was rampant across the district.<ref name="MPQ" />
